title: Yuzu tonic at the lime arch

tokens.v: She leans into the inner curve of the arch with one foot tucked up against it, holding the violet can at shoulder height with its print turned to camera, mid-laugh, looking off to the right. Styled in a cropped white ribbed tank, high-waisted cobalt wide-leg trousers and white leather sneakers. 35mm from knee height, full length with room above the arch, hard midday sun throwing her shadow across the blue floor.
